description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the DeleteThingLiveCommand interface, providing methods to create instances, set headers, and retrieve command category information within a live command context.

classes.name: DeleteThingLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable class implementing DeleteThingLiveCommand, representing a live command to delete a 'thing' with methods for command creation and configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteThingLiveCommandImpl from a Command object.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command changes authorization, always returns false.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Provides a builder for constructing responses to this command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command instance.
